Maya (PM): Heads-up: TravelNest wants an EU-first gradual rollout for model-v3 on Dedicated. Requirements: per-tenant opt-in, 2 week canary window, A/B control, and an immediate model-fallback to v2 on quality regressions. They also want audit logs for fallbacks and an SLA discussion if we do 100%.

Diego (SRE): Quick capacity note: Dedicated pool can be isolated per-customer or soft-sliced across two AZs. Isolation simplifies debugging (KV cache, host traces) but increases reserved capacity. Which do we want for initial roll?

Priya (Eng): Strong +1 for isolated pool for the first 14 days. v3 has KV cache adjustments; isolation will help narrow down cache warming issues. After 14d we can soft-slice if metrics look stable.

Ollie (CSE): Customer requires: tenant-level kill switch (UI + API), webhook for fallback events with payload {tenant_id, time, reason, before_model, after_model}, and 90d retention for webhook events in our logs.

Maya (PM): OK proposed plan:
- Isolated EU pool -> 5% control on v2, 10% opt-in v3, rest shadowed for metrics
- Roll steps: 10% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100% over 14 days with hold points at each step
- Automatic fallback to v2 if thresholds breach

Diego (SRE): Draft thresholds (suggested):
- request-error-rate (5xx + inference-exception) > 0.4% for 15m -> fallback
- hallucination metric (eval prompts) delta > 1.2% vs control over 60m -> pause rollout
- latency 95p increase > 35% sustained 10m -> fallback
- cost per token > 1.7x baseline for 30m -> throttle to 25% and notify Optimize

Priya (Eng): Additions: enable prefix KV caching for opt-in cohort, and add a metric tag rollout_id=travelnest_eu_v3 for Redwood Optimize to pick up. Also implement model-swap hook with metric annotation.

Ollie (CSE): TravelNest asked for an A/B experiment: 5% of their traffic should be assigned as control (v2) for the first 72h to validate quality delta. They want daily reports for the first week.

Maya (PM): Noted. We'll export daily diffs and a final 7-day report. Rollout gating criteria (required to advance):
1) Canary-run passes (no fatal errors, infra stable)
2) Hallucination delta <= 0.6% vs control on eval set
3) Latency 95p <= 30% over baseline
4) Cost delta <= 1.6x baseline or Optimize has recommended mitigations
5) Webhook + audit log delivery validated by CSE/legal
6) Autoscaler and pool provisioning verified by SRE

Diego (SRE): Ops checklist:
- Provision isolated EU pool (ETA: 8h)
- Bump autoscaler floor during ramp windows
- Add soft-eviction guard to keep at least 2 hosts live for instant fallback
- Expose per-tenant fallback webhook + retention settings (ETA: 1d)

RolloutBot: Scheduled canary job travelnest-eu-v3 at 2024-07-22T09:00Z. It will run smoke + eval prompts and publish metrics to /canaries/1713339999.

Priya (Eng): Dev tasks and ETAs:
- Feature flag: tenant+region scope + cohort sampling (ETA: 1 day)
- Fallback hook + event tagging (ETA: 2 days)
- Control cohort export to eval pipeline (ETA: 2 days)
- Hook webhook delivery + retry semantics (ETA: 1 day)

Ollie (CSE): I'll confirm webhook contract with TravelNest legal and schedule customer sync tomorrow. They also want the option to revert to a previous model if SLA issues are found.

Maya (PM): Timeline draft:
- Day 0: flag + dev changes merged to staging, canary scheduled
- Day 1: SRE provisions pool, internal smoke tests
- Day 2: customer canary (10% opt-in, 5% control) starts
- Day 4: decision point to move to 25% based on gating metrics
- Day 8: mid-roll review, decide 50%/100% cadence

Diego (SRE): Alerts/runbook:
- fallback events > 2 in 24h -> auto-pager to @Diego and @Maya
- fallback events > 5 in 24h -> SEV-1 and ops all-hands
- sustained cost spike > threshold -> notify Optimize team and reduce rollout to 25%

Priya (Eng): Also tagging notes: add rollout metadata to traces (rollout_id, cohort, tenant_id) so tracing and sampling correlate with rollout cohorts.

Maya (PM): I'll draft the official rollout playbook and a CSV of eval prompts for the customer to review. Ollie, please get the legal confirmation on webhook and SLA ask.

Ollie (CSE): Confirmed webhook contract signed with 90d retention. Customer will sign SLA addendum only after successful 100% rollout.

RolloutBot: Canary result: travelnest-eu-v3 SUCCESS. Metrics: error_rate=0.12%, latency_95p+18% vs baseline, hallucination_delta=+0.2%, cost_delta=+1.4x. Full logs at /canaries/1713339999.

Maya (PM): Great. If no objections, we'll start 10% opt-in tomorrow at 09:00 CET. I'll circulate the playbook after final checks. :rocket:
